import json, sys, time, urllib.request, urllib.error, os

TITLE = os.environ["TITLE"]
RADARR = "http://192.168.1.22:7878/api/v3"
PROWLARR = "http://192.168.1.21:9696/api/v1"
JELLYFIN = "http://192.168.1.20:8096"
RADARR_KEY = os.environ["RADARR_API_KEY"]
PROWLARR_KEY = os.environ["PROWLARR_API_KEY"]

def req(url, method="GET", data=None, headers=None, timeout=30):
    h = {"Accept": "application/json"}
    if headers:
        h.update(headers)
    body = None
    if data is not None:
        body = json.dumps(data).encode()
        h["Content-Type"] = "application/json"
    r = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, headers=h, method=method)
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(r, timeout=timeout) as resp:
            return json.loads(resp.read().decode())
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        detail = e.read().decode()[:500]
        print(f"HTTP {e.code} on {method} {url}: {detail}")
        raise

def main():
    print(f"=== Chain proof for: {TITLE} ===")

    # 1. Look up the title in Radarr
    print("\n[1] Radarr lookup")
    lookup = req(f"{RADARR}/movie/lookup", headers={"X-Api-Key": RADARR_KEY},
                 data={"term": TITLE})
    if not lookup:
        print("FAILED: no lookup results")
        sys.exit(1)
    movie = lookup[0]
    print(f"  found: {movie['title']} ({movie.get('year')}) tmdb={movie.get('tmdbId')}")

    # 2. Add it to Radarr
    print("\n[2] Add to Radarr")
    add_payload = {
        "title": movie["title"],
        "qualityProfileId": 1,
        "rootFolderPath": "/media/movies",
        "tmdbId": movie["tmdbId"],
        "year": movie.get("year", 0),
        "monitored": True,
        "addOptions": {"searchForMovie": True},
    }
    try:
        added = req(f"{RADARR}/movie", method="POST",
                    headers={"X-Api-Key": RADARR_KEY}, data=add_payload)
        movie_id = added["id"]
        print(f"  added: id={movie_id}")
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        if e.code == 400:
            # maybe already exists — find it
            existing = req(f"{RADARR}/movie", headers={"X-Api-Key": RADARR_KEY})
            match = [m for m in existing if m.get("tmdbId") == movie.get("tmdbId")]
            if match:
                movie_id = match[0]["id"]
                print(f"  already present: id={movie_id}")
            else:
                raise
        else:
            raise

    # 3. Trigger a search in Radarr
    print("\n[3] Radarr search")
    req(f"{RADARR}/command", method="POST", headers={"X-Api-Key": RADARR_KEY},
        data={"name": "MoviesSearch", "movieIds": [movie_id]})
    print("  search command sent")

    # 4. Wait for Radarr to grab a release (poll up to ~90s)
    print("\n[4] Waiting for Radarr to grab a release")
    grabbed = False
    for i in range(18):
        time.sleep(5)
        hist = req(f"{RADARR}/history", headers={"X-Api-Key": RADARR_KEY},
                   data={"movieId": movie_id, "pageSize": 20})
        for rec in hist.get("records", []):
            if rec.get("eventType") == "grabbed":
                print(f"  grabbed: {rec.get('sourceTitle', '')[:80]}")
                grabbed = True
                break
        if grabbed:
            break
    if not grabbed:
        print("  WARNING: no grab recorded after 90s — continuing to check qBittorrent directly")

    # 5. Check qBittorrent for the download
    print("\n[5] qBittorrent check")
    # qBittorrent Web API on guest 105, port 8080
    # We need to authenticate. The password is $MASS_PASSWORD.
    QB = "http://192.168.1.24:8080/api/v2"
    qb_pass = os.environ["MASS_PASSWORD"]
    # login
    login = req(f"{QB}/auth/login", method="POST",
                data={"username": "admin", "password": qb_pass})
    if login.get("result") != "Ok.":
        print("  FAILED: qBittorrent login failed")
        sys.exit(1)
    torrents = req(f"{QB}/torrents/info")
    active = [t for t in torrents if t.get("state") in ("downloading", "stalledDL", "uploading", "stalledUP", "pausedUP", "queuedUP", "checkingUP")]
    if active:
        for t in active[:5]:
            print(f"  torrent: {t['name'][:60]} state={t['state']} progress={t.get('progress', 0):.1%}")
    else:
        print("  no active torrents found")

    # 6. Wait for import into /media/movies
    print("\n[6] Waiting for Radarr import")
    imported = False
    for i in range(24):
        time.sleep(5)
        hist = req(f"{RADARR}/history", headers={"X-Api-Key": RADARR_KEY},
                   data={"movieId": movie_id, "pageSize": 20})
        for rec in hist.get("records", []):
            if rec.get("eventType") == "downloadFolderImported":
                print(f"  imported: {rec.get('data', {}).get('importedPath', '')}")
                imported = True
                break
        if imported:
            break
    if not imported:
        print("  WARNING: no import recorded after 120s")

    # 7. Trigger Jellyfin library scan
    print("\n[7] Jellyfin scan")
    # Jellyfin API key — read from the guest's config
    # We'll use the API key from the Jellyfin config file
    # For now, trigger a library scan via the API without auth (may need key)
    # Actually Jellyfin requires an API key. We'll read it from the guest.
    # The key is in /etc/jellyfin/database.xml or we can use the API key endpoint.
    # Simpler: use the Jellyfin API key stored in the system.
    # We'll read it from the guest's config.
    import subprocess
    key_out = subprocess.run(
        ["pct", "exec", "101", "--", "bash", "-c",
         "grep -oP '(?<=<ApiKey>)[^<]+' /etc/jellyfin/database.xml | head -1"],
        capture_output=True, text=True)
    jf_key = key_out.stdout.strip()
    if not jf_key:
        print("  WARNING: could not read Jellyfin API key — trying without")
        jf_key = ""
    scan = req(f"{JELLYFIN}/Library/Refresh",
               method="POST",
               headers={"X-Emby-Token": jf_key} if jf_key else {})
    print("  scan triggered")

    # 8. Wait for Jellyfin to list the title
    print("\n[8] Waiting for Jellyfin to list the title")
    found = False
    for i in range(24):
        time.sleep(5)
        items = req(f"{JELLYFIN}/Items",
                    headers={"X-Emby-Token": jf_key} if jf_key else {},
                    data={"Recursive": "true", "IncludeItemTypes": "Movie", "SearchTerm": TITLE})
        if items.get("Items"):
            for it in items["Items"]:
                print(f"  Jellyfin lists: {it['Name']} ({it.get('ProductionYear', '')})")
                found = True
                break
        if found:
            break
    if not found:
        print("  WARNING: title not yet listed in Jellyfin after 120s")

    # 9. Verify file on disk
    print("\n[9] File on disk")
    disk = subprocess.run(
        ["pct", "exec", "103", "--", "bash", "-c",
         f"find /media/movies -maxdepth 2 -iname '*{TITLE[:20]}*' -type f 2>/dev/null | head -5"],
        capture_output=True, text=True)
    if disk.stdout.strip():
        print(f"  files found:\n{disk.stdout.strip()}")
    else:
        print("  WARNING: no files found under /media/movies matching the title")

    print("\n=== Chain proof complete ===")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
